desc: rolls is the number of pins knocked down by each roll of one ten-pin bowling game. First, if any roll is below 0 or above 10, return the error "invalid roll". Then read frames in order. In frames 1 to 9, a 10 on the first roll is a strike and ends the frame; otherwise the frame has two rolls, and if they sum to more than 10 return "too many pins in frame N" (N is the frame number). In frame 10: after a strike come two bonus rolls, and unless the first bonus roll is 10, the two bonus rolls may not sum to more than 10; otherwise the frame has two rolls that may not sum to more than 10, plus one bonus roll if they sum to exactly 10 (a spare). A frame-10 violation is "too many pins in frame 10". If the rolls run out before the game is complete, return "incomplete game"; if rolls are left over after frame 10, return "too many rolls". The first problem met while reading left to right wins. Otherwise return the score: each frame scores its pins, plus the next two rolls after a strike, plus the next roll after a spare, in frames 1 to 9; frame 10 scores just the pins of all its rolls.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
